comment: She is a lovely lady and I have nothing against her, I just don't think she's my "type" of teacher.  Not very good at getting the class involved, the topics of the class aren't too cohesive throughout the year and I find myself questioning what the purpore of the class is.  Outside of class, very sweet and caring.

Professoressa Skeen is an amazing professor and only talks in Italian. She cares about her students and just wants everyone to participate. As long as you try you generally aren't penalized for wrong answers. She is very funny and laid back but does not appreciate it at all if nobody is participating, so speak up and she'll automatically love you!
Participate and you will be fine.
many opportunities for extra credit, hard tests, doesn't explain topics well
